learned_selectors: main a[href] (fallback for unseen listing layouts)
rationale: The supplied listing evidence identifies product detail links by product-card anchors inside the main content. Scrolling exposes additional listing anchors, so links are collected after each bounded scroll and prioritized over initially visible links.
assumptions: Detail pages are same-origin links from the main listing content.
api.scroll performs a bounded scroll gesture and may reveal additional anchors.
The runtime has already opened input.start_url, and api.save records a previously observed detail link.
